Hi, This is my first post here (Thanks Colin ).

I've been looking around, but couldn't find any information.

Are there any photopolymer films that are commericially available for use for hobbyists?

I know there are companies that make photopolymers (Dupont), for example, but they don't appear to be commercially available.

posts.author: Sergio
posts.content_md:
> **WingedOne:** Hi, This is my first post here (Thanks Colin).I've been looking around, but couldn't find any information.Are there any photopolymer films that are commericially available for use for hobbyists?I know there are companies that make photopolymers (Dupont), for example, but they don't appear to be commercially available.

Liquid photopolymers are available for rapid prototype work as well a new dry photopolymer material for hobbyists coat your own plates. The dry photopolymer is as sensitive as some silver halide materials for reflection holograms and is 'red' laser sensitive, no development is necessary.

Sergio.
